attributes.title: ARIN 2027 Conference
attributes.summary:
The Association for Radiologic & Imaging Nursing holds its 2027 Conference from July 25 to 28, 2027, in San Jose, California. The meeting is for nurses who work in interventional radiology, diagnostic imaging, CT and MRI suites and related procedural areas, where sedation, contrast safety and procedural care are core topics.

ARIN says more details are coming soon. The venue, fees, contact hours and hotel arrangements for 2027 had not been posted when we checked; only exhibitor and sponsorship options were available.
